content.title: Toggle the full-width Activity section off and back on from Customize
content.intent: Prove a full-row dashboard section can be hidden, the row is removed cleanly, and the section returns when re-enabled.
content.technique_notes: Techniques: equivalence partitioning over section-layout classes + state / flow. I kept a separate full-width representative because the dashboard grid defines Recent Activity as a 12-column row, which creates a different reflow shape from card sections. Risk strength judged as 2 because only user-reach applied; no money, auth, or data-loss factors were evidenced.
